Placeholders.title: Dynamic placeholders
Placeholders.desc: Reference page for §7.2 variables, sources and fallback rules. Not a configuration editor.
Placeholders.tipDesc: Write variables as '{{ key }}'; use '{{ key | fallback }}' for defaults. Templates and campaigns only insert these agreed variables.
Placeholders.copyFail: Copy failed; select the syntax manually
Placeholders.rule1: If a variable is empty or missing, the value after the pipe is used first.
Placeholders.rule2: Without a fallback and with a missing variable, that recipient is skipped (MISSING_VAR).
Placeholders.rule3: Custom field keys support Chinese, letters, digits, underscores and dotted paths.
Placeholders.p_name_fallback: Use '{{姓名|friend}}'; without a fallback, empty values skip the email.
Placeholders.p_company_fallback: Use '{{公司|your company}}'; without a fallback, empty values skip the email.
Placeholders.p_title_fallback: Use '{{职位|contact}}'; without a fallback, empty values skip the email.
Placeholders.p_email_fallback: Active contacts always have email; you may still set an explicit fallback.
Placeholders.p_salutation_source: Uses the contact's custom field 称呼 when set; otherwise generated from country/region: China → surname + 总监/经理 (e.g. 王经理), other standard countries/regions → English first name (e.g. John).
Placeholders.p_salutation_fallback: Use '{{称呼|Hello}}' for when it can't be generated: empty or non-ISO 3166-1 country, unsplittable surname, or a title without 总监/经理. Without a fallback, the email is skipped.
Placeholders.p_ai_source: Campaign AI block output in message.ai_content
Placeholders.p_ai_fallback: Block keys are defined per campaign; referencing a missing block fails validation.
Placeholders.p_custom_source: Matching key in contact custom_fields, e.g. '{{行业}}'
